acip: RTAGS GNYIS PA MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA CHOS CAN, DNGOS PO DANG 'GAL BA YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD DNGOS PO DANG THA DAD, KHYOD YANG YIN DNGOS PO YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rtags gnyis pa ma grub na, rtag pa chos can, dngos po dang 'gal ba yin par thal, khyod dngos po dang tha dad, khyod yang yin dngos po yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa med pa'i phyir
english: Then I disagree with the second part of your reason: unchanging things are not contradictory to a working thing. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then unchanging things. They are too contradictory to a working thing, Because (1) they are separate from working things; and (2) there exists no example of something which is both an unchanging thing and also a working thing.
